integrity: Full proof, exact 256-rule classification and two separately coded deterministic verification programs are supplied. Claims of computation are limited to executable checks from these accompanying paths.
limitations: One update of elementary binary radius-one cellular automata on the bi-infinite full shift; periodic targets must be attainable. The finite 256-rule classification uses exhaustive Boolean-matrix semigroup computation. Does not classify all precursor periods, temporal orbits or higher-radius rules; independent audit and exhaustive historical-priority verification not performed.
title: Sharp universal period lifting for one-step elementary cellular automata
